title: Jazzy Smoky Roasted Tunisian Galangal-Kha Tagine
description: Savory Smoky Tunisian dish fit for any occasion, made with galangal-kha and satvik-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tandoor over medium heat.
Add sliced galangal-kha and cook until slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add diced chicken, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika and cook until chicken is browned on all sides.
Add sliced onion and cook until it starts to soften.
Add salt and black pepper to taste, stir well.
Add lemon juice and stir well.
Cover the tandoor and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with dried cilantro and serve hot.
Let stand for a few minutes to allow the juices to redistribute, then serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Tagine can be served with rice or naan bread, or enjoyed on its own for a satisfying meal.
